raw_text: An Oil India Limited crude oil pipeline in Tinsukia district has been sabotaged in what appears to be a coordinated militant attack. Two valve stations along the critical Duliajan-Numaligarh corridor were hit using IEDs, causing a major crude oil spill that has contaminated approximately 12 hectares of ecologically sensitive wetland. ULFA-I has claimed responsibility through its official Telegram channel.
clean_text: OIL pipeline sabotaged in Tinsukia with IEDs at two valve stations on Duliajan-Numaligarh corridor. 12 hectares of wetland contaminated. ULFA-I claims responsibility.
